info.name: Railway Reservation System
info.description: End-to-end tests for the Railway Reservation microservices. All business calls go through the API gateway (default http://localhost:8080). Run folders in numeric order. Collection variables are filled automatically by test scripts. See TESTING_GUIDE.md for the full walkthrough.

item.name: 0. Infrastructure checks
item.description: Run these first. Everything must be UP/RUNNING before testing business flows.

request.description: Expect 6 apps registered: API-GATEWAY, TRAIN-CATALOG-SERVICE, FARE-SERVICE, BOOKING-COMMAND-SERVICE, PAYMENT-SERVICE, BOOKING-QUERY-SERVICE.

item.name: 7. Resilience and observability (gateway)
item.description: Rate limiting, circuit breaker/fallback, retry and metrics.

request.description: Run this single request in the Collection Runner: 300 iterations, delay 0 ms. Limit is 50 req/s with burst 100 per client IP, so some responses become 429. Successful responses carry X-RateLimit-* headers.

item.name: Circuit breaker / retry fallback (stop fare-service first)

request.description: MANUAL: run `docker compose stop fare-service`, then send this. booking-command retries 3x (exponential back-off), the circuit breaker records failures, and the fallback returns 503. Restore with `docker compose start fare-service`.
MANUAL: `docker compose stop booking-command-service`, send this. The gateway CircuitBreaker filter forwards to /fallback/booking and returns a JSON 503 body.
